Class SkipToPreviousRequest

java.lang.Object
se.michaelthelin.spotify.requests.AbstractRequest<String>
se.michaelthelin.spotify.requests.data.AbstractDataRequest<String>
se.michaelthelin.spotify.requests.data.player.SkipToPreviousRequest
All Implemented Interfaces:
IRequest<String>
public class SkipToPreviousRequest extends AbstractDataRequest<String>
Skips to previous track in the user’s queue.

Note: This will ALWAYS skip to the previous track, regardless of the current track’s progress. Returning to the start of the current track should be performed using a SeekToPositionRequest.
